## Research interests

Energy and environmental policy; public acceptance of low-carbon energy technologies, including hydrogen, ammonia, offshore wind and marine renewables; climate change adaptation and mitigation policy; disaster preparedness and community resilience; public preferences for water and energy resource management; quantitative and mixed-methods policy research.

## Teaching & supervision

At Oregon State University, I taught **22 sections across 8 courses over 21 terms**, with approximately **600 course enrolments**. At GC University Lahore, I taught **45 sections across 15 courses**, totalling **1,661 students**. I have supervised **6 MPhil, 8 MA and 15 BA (Hons) research projects involving 39 students**.

[See teaching and mentoring →](teaching.html)

## Research methods & technical skills

**Quantitative:** survey design and implementation; choice-based conjoint analysis; structural equation modelling; path analysis; cluster analysis; exploratory factor analysis; hierarchical regression; OLS, logistic, ordinal and multinomial logistic regression; fixed-, random- and mixed-effects models.

**Experimental & quasi-experimental:** randomised controlled trials; instrumental variables; regression discontinuity; difference-in-differences; programme evaluation.

**Qualitative & mixed methods:** interviews; focus groups; deliberative workshops; ethnographic fieldwork; interpretative phenomenological analysis; discourse analysis; grounded theory; participatory rural appraisal.

**Software:** advanced proficiency in Stata, SPSS and AMOS; proficiency in Excel; working knowledge of R, Python and NVivo.
